name: labs/bionanomics__microscope-agent
title: Baumer VCXU-23C GenICam camera
intro: Baumer VCXU-23C GenICam camera, adapted from bionanomics/microscope-agent. It reads `exposure_time_range_us`, `gain_range`, `pixel_format` and `balance_white_auto`; sets `exposure_time_us` and `gain`; runs `capture`. `capture`: capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
